snippet.title: Gravel – Colorado River DLC Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Expand your Gravel experience with the latest and greatest, the Colorado River DLC! Experience the new Wild Rush map, four new circuit tracks and a whole new career episode.

The hot sizzling Arizona desert is the perfect place for a new Off-road Masters episode. Gravel Channel returns to the U.S.A. with four new tracks and spectacular Wild Rush races organized around a dam on the Colorado River!
 
Gravel Colorado River, included in the Season Pass, is available now for purchase for PlayStation®4 system.

http://gravelvideogame.com
